references.text: Here it is told about a man of the house of Levi who took a Levite woman as his wife, and she bore a son (Moses). This confirms Jokebed's marriage to Amram and the birth of Moses.
This text gives the same genealogical information: Amram took his aunt Jokebed as his wife, and she bore him Aaron and Moses.
Miriam is called a prophetess and Aaron's sister, which confirms the sibling relationship mentioned in Numbers 26:59.
It mentions Aaron and Moses as descendants of Levi, consistent with the lineage through Jokebed.
The book of Chronicles confirms Amram's marriage and names his children: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam.
Miriam and Aaron are referred to as Moses' siblings, confirming the family relationship in Numbers 26:59.
